page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t1.small is an entry-tier virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The configuration provides 1 dedicated vCPU based on the x86_64 architecture and 1.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:1 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance does not bundle local disk storage or hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

The processor profile indicates an absence of advanced instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512) and hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions like AES. Persistent storage requirements must be met using external block storage because local disks are not included. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

With its minimal resource footprint, ecs.t1.small targets non-critical background services, lightweight monitoring daemons, simple automation scripts, or development test benches. Its low resource allocation provides an economical footprint for basic operational tasks that do not require high throughput, large memory buffers, or specialized vector instruction execution.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t1.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 processor architecture, it provides 1 dedicated vCPU paired with 1.0 GB of RAM. The instance lacks local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data, and features no attached graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Advanced CPU instructions such as AVX vector processing and AES cryptographic acceleration are not enabled. Designed for minimal resource utilization, this instance provides a cost-effective environment for low-intensity workloads. It is best suited for lightweight background services, simple automation agents, test environments, and low-traffic internal utility scripts operating within strict memory constraints.
